_comment: Hooks that MUST reach Claude Code's own runtime, merged by bootstrap into
~/.claude/settings.json (NOT settings.local.json).
Measured 2026-07-26 on Claude Code 2.1.220: a hook registered in
~/.claude/settings.local.json never fires. Controlled A/B — same hook, same
absolute command, only the file differed — the settings.json registration
fired on every Agent dispatch and the settings.local.json one fired zero
times. Path style was ruled out separately: an absolute command in
settings.local.json also never fired, so the tilde is not the cause. At USER
scope Claude Code reads settings.json; settings.local.json is a PROJECT-scope
file (.claude/settings.local.json), and a copy at ~/.claude/ is inert.
The defect is FILE-level, not event- or matcher-level. Confirmed with a
second controlled A/B on a different event: the same PostToolUse:Write probe
fired zero times from settings.local.json and fired from settings.json. So
EVERY hook Manifest used to register in settings.local.json was inert on a
deployed machine, which is why all of them now live here.
Before migrating, each hook was probed with a representative payload to check
it behaves when it finally runs (these had never executed in production): all
exit 0 (non-blocking), guidance_hint/spec_review are silent on
ordinary edits, lint_on_edit emits advisory output only on a genuine lint
error, and all three PostToolUse hooks chained on one edit cost ~240ms.
STILL INERT, deliberately not moved here: settings.local.json also carries
`permissions` (31 allow-rules), `mcpServers` (sentry, context7, linear,
atlassian) and `skillListingBudgetFraction: 0.05`. Those have the same
root cause but different blast radii — granting permissions changes the
security posture and enabling MCP servers opens connections to external
services — so they are a separate, explicit decision rather than a
ride-along. See docs/MODEL-POLICY.md.
The `~` in the commands below is expanded by merge_claude_runtime_hooks at
deploy time; Claude Code is given an absolute path.

hooks.command: echo 'token-conserve: lead with result; terse; surgical edits; one targeted question if ambiguous'
